action.help: repeat the reviewed preview's --check-population FILE beneath ROOT

help.stdout:
usage: gnd evolve apply [-h] --preview PREVIEW --workspace WORKSPACE --records
                        RECORDS [--policy {additive}] [--populated FACT_TYPE]
                        [--check-population FILE] [--format {text,json}]
                        model proposal

Require PROPOSAL and PREVIEW to reproduce the current exact preview, obtain
the exact blast-radius digest for a breaking proposal, publish the candidate
model CAS and durable pending-finalization evidence, then complete the
verbalization, live linked-project conformance, and final record in the same
invocation. The exit is the raw aggregate conformance exit, so linked drift
returns 13 with the model published and no rollback.

positional arguments:
  model                 current model file beneath ROOT
  proposal              closed evolution proposal JSON beneath ROOT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --preview PREVIEW     exact reviewed PREVIEW JSON beneath ROOT
  --workspace WORKSPACE
                        authoritative existing workspace ROOT
  --records RECORDS     authoritative immutable evidence DIR
  --policy {additive}   refuse operations outside the additive policy (see the
                        evolution contract)
  --populated FACT_TYPE
                        treat FACT_TYPE as populated under --policy additive;
                        repeatable
  --check-population FILE
                        repeat the reviewed preview's --check-population FILE
                        beneath ROOT
  --format {text,json}  output rendering: human-readable text (default) or one
                        JSON payload

action.help: check new or strengthened proposed deontic constraints on populated fact types against the population in FILE beneath ROOT; requires --policy additive

help.stdout:
usage: gnd evolve preview [-h] --workspace WORKSPACE --records RECORDS --out
                          OUT [--policy {additive}] [--populated FACT_TYPE]
                          [--shape-report] [--check-population FILE]
                          [--format {text,json}]
                          model proposal

Read MODEL and PROPOSAL beneath the authoritative workspace, validate the
candidate and blast radius, and write the complete digest-bound preview to
PREVIEW without changing the model, verbalization, records, or linked
projects.

positional arguments:
  model                 current model file beneath ROOT
  proposal              closed evolution proposal JSON beneath ROOT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workspace WORKSPACE
                        authoritative existing workspace ROOT
  --records RECORDS     authoritative immutable evidence DIR
  --out OUT             write-once PREVIEW JSON path beneath ROOT
  --policy {additive}   refuse operations outside the additive policy (see the
                        evolution contract)
  --populated FACT_TYPE
                        treat FACT_TYPE as populated under --policy additive;
                        repeatable
  --shape-report        list existing fact types with the same role players as
                        each added one (advice only)
  --check-population FILE
                        check new or strengthened proposed deontic constraints
                        on populated fact types against the population in FILE
                        beneath ROOT; requires --policy additive
  --format {text,json}  output rendering: human-readable text (default) or one
                        JSON payload
